rides.title: Women's Road Ride
rides.description:
Due to the weather forecast we have shorten the route :) 

Join us for our Women's Road Ride. This is a longer endurance ride. We will ride together as one group all the way along the route. We will change taking turns at the front all the way. We will aim for an average speed of 28 - 30 km/t. We expect people are used to riding in a group and are familiar with the signs being used in a group. Usually we finish the ride at the shop for a drink or something to eat.
If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!

Meeting time: 10.00
Start time: 10.15
Distance: 100-120 km +/-
Pace: 28- 30 km/h
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event.
#Womensride

rides.title: Women's Social Ride
rides.description:
Join us for a Women's Social Ride. We will ride together all the way and change taking turns at the front along the route. We will clearly go through how to ride in a group and which signals we are using before heading out. We expect you are an experienced cyclist and have tried to ride among other cyclist a decent amount of times. It is mandatory to have a cycling computer, where you can download the route. If you have any trouble downloading the route please show up in advance to get help from the store staff or rideleaders. This is not a beginners ride, and  we expect all riders to take care of their own bikes. 
If you have any questions always reach out to our rideleaders or come by the store.

Looking forward to see you!

rides.title: Training Ride
rides.description:
Join us for our Training Ride — a challenging group session designed to push your limits alongside dedicated cyclists. We'll ride intervals on different loops, and always regrouping afterwards to return to the city together. During transport we’ll ride as a one group, rotating turns at the front. Riders should be comfortable with group riding and familiar with standard hand and vocal signals. If you have a puncture or mechanical issue, we expect you have the route downloaded and will to rejoin the group on your own. We run a monthly rotation of efforts to vary the training. We encourage doing intervals in smaller groups when appropriate.

Week 1: 2 x 12 min at Uvelse 
Week 2: 3 x 8 min at Kettinge **   
Week 3: 4 x 4 min at Bregnerød 
Week 4: Small race at Flyveren 2 laps in total 

If you have any questions please reach out. Looking forward seeing you!

rides.title: Shake-out ride | Day before COPENHAGEN to OSLO | Nordic Chase 2026
rides.description:
The Pre-Chase Shake Out 🇩🇰🥐

One final spin before the big push to Oslo!

This ride is all about the ice breaker. Use these kms to meet the riders you’ll be chasing over the next few days. It’s also the perfect time for a final equipment test.

📍 The Details

When: Friday, June 5th, 2026

Meetup: 3:30 PM

Roll-out: 3:30 PM Sharp ⏱️

Start Point: Dampfærgevej 30, 2100 København (Official Race Start)

Distance: ~54 km (Social shake out)

Pace: 27–28 km/h

Finish: Back at  GoNordic HQ (Dampfærgevej 30) for the Rider Briefing at 5h30 pm

🛠️ What You Need to Know

Groups: We will split into smaller groups on the road to keep things safe.
Navigation: Please ensure you have the route downloaded to your head unit. ⚠️
Kit: Bring a flat kit for punctures and your best post-taper vibes.

Waitlist / Registration 🚨
The official race to Oslo is currently sold out! If you aren't on the roster yet but still want to join the chase, shoot us an email to see if we can squeeze you in:

👉 info@nordicchase.com

See you there! ✌️

rides.title: 2 Days of Sport - Gravel Ride
rides.description:
Join os til et gravel ride.
Vi skyder 2 Days of Sport i gang med en fælles tur ud på gruset. Vi deler op i to grupper – 24–25 km/t og 27–29 km/t – og ruller samlet ud fra Copenhagen Cycling Club mod de nordsjællandske skove.

Ruten kombinerer lange stræk med champagnegrus, mindre tekniske sektioner og noget af den smukkeste natur, Nordsjælland har at byde på. En tur med plads til både tempo, oplevelser og gode samtaler undervejs.

Husk energi, plugs, vand og gode vibes.

Vi forventer, at alle har ruten på deres cykelcomputer, tidligere har kørt gravel og selv kan håndtere en punktering.

Når vi er tilbage, er der snacks fra Kcal, mulighed for at købe kaffe og sodavand – og tid til at hænge ud med andre ryttere og løbere. 

Derudover kan du opleve og teste produkter fra Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company og Pine Athletic Skincare.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 08:45 Roll-out: 09:00ish
 Distance: ~70 km 
Pace groups: 23–24 km/t · 25–26 km/t Surface: Gravel
—
English
Join us for a gravel ride.
We kick off 2 Days of Sport with a shared ride into the gravel roads and forests north of Copenhagen. We’ll split into two pace groups – 24–25 km/h and 27–29 km/h – and roll out together from Copenhagen Cycling Club.

The route combines fast-flowing gravel, smaller technical sections and some of the most beautiful forest roads and nature North Zealand has to offer. A ride built around pace, good conversations and time spent outside.

Bring energy, plugs, water and good vibes.

We expect everyone to have the route loaded on their bike computer, previous gravel experience and the ability to fix a flat.

Back at the club there will be snacks from Kcal, coffee and soft drinks available to purchase, and time to hang out with fellow riders and runners. 
You’ll also get the chance to explore and test products from Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company and Pine Athletic Skincare.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 08:45 Roll-out: 09:00ish
 Distance: ~70 km 
Pace groups: 24–25 km/h · 27–28 km/h 
Surface: Gravel

rides.title: Women only - Road Ride by Strada Elite Women
rides.description:
Women only ride by Strada Elite Women
Lørdag eftermiddag fortsætter 2 Days of Sport med en fælles tur på landevejen – kun for kvinder. Turen ledes af ryttere fra Strada Elite Women, og vi ruller samlet ud fra Copenhagen Cycling Club mod nogle af de bedste landeveje i Nordsjælland.

Ruten byder på smukke landeveje, smooth tarmac og cirka 80 km i godt selskab. En tur med fokus på fællesskab, gode føringer, snak undervejs og mange gode kilometer i sadlen.

Husk energi, vand og gode vibes.

Vi forventer, at alle har ruten på deres cykelcomputer, tidligere har kørt landevej og er vant til at køre i gruppe.

Når vi er tilbage, fortsætter eftermiddagen i butikken. Der vil være mulighed for at købe pizza (bestilles inden vi ruller ud), købe sodavand, øl og måske en lille drink – mens DJ’en sørger for stemningen.
Derudover kan du opleve og teste produkter fra Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company og Pine Athletic Skincare.

Veninder, kærester, mænd og familie er meget velkomne til at joine den sociale del efterfølgende. Hvis de ønsker pizza, skal den bestilles senest kl. 15.

Meeting point: Copenhagen Cycling Club
 Meet up: 14:45 
Roll-out: 14:00ish 
Distance: ~80 km 
Surface: Road 
Ride leaders: Strada Elite Women
—
Women only road ride.
On Saturday afternoon, 2 Days of Sport continues with a shared ride on the road – exclusively for women. 
The ride will be led by riders from Strada Elite Women as we roll out together from Copenhagen Cycling Club towards some of the best roads north of Copenhagen.

The route combines beautiful roads, smooth tarmac and around 80 km of good company. A ride built around community, smooth turns, conversations and plenty of quality kilometres in the saddle.

Bring energy, water and good vibes.

We expect everyone to have the route loaded on their bike computer, previous road riding experience and to be comfortable riding in a group.

Back at the club, the afternoon continues. There will be the option to buy pizza (order before roll-out), along with soft drinks, beers and maybe a small drink – while a DJ sets the atmosphere.
You’ll also get the chance to explore and test products from Puronia, Sloe, Good Habit Company and Pine Athletic Skincare.

Friends, partners, men and family are all welcome to join the social gathering afterwards. If they would like pizza, orders must be placed before 15:00.

rides.description:
Join us on June 25th for this Women’s Intermediate ride led by our team of Rapha Ride Leaders; Lola, Olivia, Signe & Nora. 

If you’re experienced in a group ride setting and looking for a faster ride then this intermediate ride is for you. These rides will take place with an average speed of 28-30kmh. 

We will ride at a pace of 28-30kmh average. Please ensure you have knowledge of the common hand and voice signals before joining. 

Please remember to bring inner tubes, CO2 cartridges, water and snacks for the ride. Please also download the route onto your computer in advance.

Flat pedals, TT bikes and mountain bikes are not permitted on this ride. 

Meet-up: 17:00 at the Rapha Copenhagen Clubhouse (Kristen Bernikows Gade 7)
Departure: 17:15
Pace: 28-30kmh

We look forward to riding with you! 

If you can no longer join this ride, we kindly ask you to leave the ride on Strava so we can open your spot up to the next rider.

rides.title: Women's Social Ride x Pizza
rides.description:
Join us for a Women's Social Ride and Pizza in the store after the ride. We will ride together all the way and change taking turns at the front along the route. We will clearly go through how to ride in a group and which signals we are using before heading out, if anyone is new. We expect you have click pedals, are capable of sitting on someone's wheel, and can handle your bike safely. Please make sure to download the route to your cycling computer, or ask the store staff or rideleader for help in advance.

It cost 100 DKK, if you wan't to join for Pizza in the store after the ride. You can pay at the desk before heading out on the ride. It is possible to leave a bag in the store. If you have any questions always reach out to our rideleaders or come by the store.
Looking forward to see you!

Meeting Point: Århusgade 126, 2150 Nordhavn
Meeting time: 17.00
Start time: 17.15
Distance: 55 km +/-
Pace: 26-28 km/h +/-
Surface: Road
____________________
Bring a spare tube/plugs/tools, ride food and hydration. For everyone's safety, please obey all traffic lights and signs. If you have any questions do not hesitate to ask the rider leader at the event. And please download the route before the ride. Please "attend" if you intend to join the event. If you have any questions do not hesitate to contact us via copenhagen@pasnormalstudios.com
#Socialride #Womensride

rides.title: Berlin to Copenhagen - Gravel Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
The Nordic Chase is expanding!
We’re launching a brand-new race in 2026: Berlin → Copenhagen.

For this race we are partnering with Standert as host partner in Berlin.

This gravel route takes riders through Germany and Denmark, covering historic towns, rolling farmland, forests, and scenic gravel paths — finishing in the heart of Copenhagen.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

Registrations are open:
👉 www.nordicchase.com
(limited capacity at 100 riders)

Registration includes:
1. Rider briefing and Pasta Party @Standert Bicycles (store in Berlin)
2. Official Race Manual with the race details
3. Race cap and other goodies
4. Live GPS tracking
5. Finisher Certificate
6. Post-ride ceremony with drinks in Copenhagen
7. Photos taken by our media team
8. Entry to WhatsApp group chat to connect other riders
9. Small bag transfer rom the start to the finish

All info is on www.nordicchase.com

Questions, then email to info@nordicchase.com

Please note: The final route and exact start location in Berlin will be provided in the race manual. The current route is a draft and will be verified by the organizer. The manual will be emailed to all registered participants three weeks before the race.

rides.title: Copenhagen to Oslo - Gravel Edition - Part of Nordic Chase 2026 (Ultra Cycling Series)
rides.description:
🌲 Nordic Chase – Gravel Edition 2026 🚴‍♀️
Copenhagen → Oslo | Self-Supported Ultra-Distance Race

The Nordic Chase returns in 2026!

This Strava event is for the Gravel Edition, taking riders on a wild and scenic journey from Copenhagen to Oslo, crossing Denmark, Sweden, and Norway through remote gravel paths, dense forests, serene meadows, and untouched Nordic wilderness.

🔘 Official Dotwatcher.cc event
📍 Live tracking via FollowMyChallenge.com

🌍 Full route details and event schedule will be posted on:
👉 www.nordicchase.com/gravel

Registrations are now full — we’ve reached our limit of 100 riders.

For more information, please visit www.nordicchase.com or contact us at info@nordicchase.com

Please note that the final route and exact start location will be provided in the race manual.

The race manual will be shared by email with all registered participants. The race manual is scheduled for release on July 23rd, 2026.
